description.value: Day's Reading. Once per scene, take a sip. The GM names a single mood-word that describes the current scene's emotional center: tense. desperate. hollow. tender. funny. You may use that word in conversation as if you'd been told it directly by an authority figure. (NPCs accept it as plausibly true.) The thermos refills overnight. Coffee is non-negotiable.

item.signature: Always hot. Tastes vary. Don't ask what flavor it is today.
